document.about: Federal Reserve Board Financial Stability Report, April 2025. Its tables (1.1, 2.1, 3.1, 4.1) set their header as a shaded band of four cells under a rule; the cells' dividers and the table's sides are drawn as very short horizontal strokes with a thick pen, and the body is ruled by nothing.

notes: 2026-11-25 (#287): the header's three dividers are 0.5-pt horizontal segments stroked with a 36-pt pen, and the sides 1-pt segments with a 321-pt pen. Read by their outlines they were one horizontal rule through the header (y 127.9) and two stubs, so the header was cut in two and read in part, `Item` an h6. A stroke shorter than its pen is a bar across it: three vertical dividers and two sides.

2026-11-25 (#287): with the rules right, no reader took the band as the header: the body is read from its alignment or its text under it. A shaded band at a table's top, divided into cells by verticals standing on its top rule and ending at its foot, is the header row of the table read under it, one cell a column.

checks.issue: #287: each table's `Item` was an h6 above it.
